verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a machine-readable OpenAPI document is downloadable at https://clickhouse.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key), which directly satisfies the story. The evidence is limited to that single probe, so its scope (e.g. whether it covers the Cloud control-plane API or the HTTP query interface) and how complete it is cannot be judged. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the spec and its coverage, versioning or changelog details, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec is complete and usable for tooling or codegen.
